mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has stabilized at -20.4% over the last two weeks after a steep decline from -38.6%. This plateau signals exhaustion of downward momentum. failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days remains below -20% or declines further below -20.4%.

This transit recovery directly enables retail access and reduces friction to shopping trips. RETAIL_REC will rise over the next four weeks as transit capacity supports foot traffic.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not increase relative to the last 28 days, or TRANSIT falls below -15% in any of the next two weeks.
